title: feat(spec,cli): positions and permission sets are translatable — `positions` and `permissions` in the translation bundle
body:
Fixes #25652

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Ruling-ref: none; triage first grade 6385078248 (a protocol addition under the standing order, p1)

## What

A translation bundle can now carry positions and permission sets:

```ts
positions: { srm_legal_counsel: { label: 'Legal Counsel' } },
permissions: { srm_contract_reviewer: { label: 'Contract Review', description: '…' } },
```

Before, the same `en` entry in a Chinese-authored app (hotsrm#22) failed `objectstack validate` with `Unrecognized key(s) on this locale of the translation bundle: positions`, so position and permission-set labels stayed in the authoring language while every object, app and flow label beside them was translated, and `os i18n check --strict` had nowhere to report the gap.

- **`@objectstack/spec` (`system/translation.zod.ts`):** two new groups on the shared per-app shape, so the bundle entry (`TranslationData`), the registered `translation` item and the platform bundle all accept them. Each is keyed by the item's `name` and closed at `label` / `description` (strict: any other key is refused; `name` / `title` are refused with a message pointing at `label`, and `position` / `permission` / `permissionSets` with a message pointing at the groups). The group for permission sets is spelled `permissions`, as the stack spells the collection.
- **`@objectstack/spec` (`system/i18n-resolver.ts`):** `translatePosition` and `translatePermissionSet`, registered in `METADATA_DOCUMENT_TRANSLATORS`. `TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES` is derived from that table and `@objectstack/rest` reads it, so `GET /meta/position` and `GET /meta/permission` (list and item, both transports) are now served in the request's locale. These two lists are what the console's `position-ref` and `permission-ref` pickers draw. A key the bundle does not carry leaves the authored string, and an untouched document keeps its reference.
- **`@objectstack/spec` (liveness ledger):** `translation/positions` and `translation/permissions` were added as `live`, with drilled `label` / `description` children. They were seeded together with their reader (the datasets precedent), never declared first and wired later.
- **`@objectstack/cli`:** `os i18n extract` walks `positions[]` and `permissions[]` (`walkSecurityCatalog`), and `os i18n check` / `os lint` coverage report a gap in each group's own bucket (`i18n/missing-position`, `i18n/missing-permission`). Every key is recorded with `pushOptional`, so a string nobody wrote is never required to have a translation.
- **`@objectstack/lint`:** `translation-target-unknown` resolves each `positions.NAME` key against the stack's `positions[]` names and each `permissions.NAME` key against its `permissions[]` names, sibling packages' declarations included. An unknown name is an `error` with the nearest declared name; the audience anchors `everyone` / `guest` always resolve. `os explain translation-target-unknown` names both legs.
- **`scripts/fixtures/i18n-walk-parity/every-group.stack.json`:** authors one member of each new group, so `check:i18n-walk-parity` sees both walked.
- **`packages/runtime` meta-list projection census:** `permission` / `permissions` joined the list axis, and `position` / `permission` joined the item axis. The census requires every translatable type to be a cell. The reference-moves block pins the zh-CN label on both reads.
- **`examples/app-crm`, `examples/app-showcase`:** zh-CN translations for their 5 + 19 positions and permission sets. The new walk counts them, and without these `check:i18n-coverage` grew 101 → 109 (crm) and 320 → 349 (showcase). The fix was to translate them, not to raise the ratchet.
- **Docs:** the group lists in `protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx` and `ui/translations.mdx` now include the new groups. They also include the missing `picklists` / `picklist`, which those same sentences claimed exhaustively. The leg table in `i18n-standard.mdx` names the two new `translation-target-unknown` legs.

## Acceptance notes

- **Deviation from the claim's file surface (and the reason):** the claim scoped the spec half to the schema, typegen and CLI coverage, with the overlay left to objectui. Shipping the schema alone would have declared a key that parses clean and translates nothing until a downstream card lands. That is the declared-not-enforced shape this file pays to remove (Prime Directive #10, the datasets precedent in the liveness ledger). The console's pickers already read `/meta/position` and `/meta/permission`, so the one-line registration in the translator table is the overlay for those two surfaces, and the runtime census had to learn the two cells. Anywhere else the console renders a position or permission-set label from another source still belongs to objectui's card.
- **`@objectstack/lint`:** `translation-target-unknown` resolves `positions.NAME` / `permissions.NAME` against the declared names (anchors `everyone` / `guest` always resolve); an unknown name is an error. Added in patch round 1, after the dev reported the silent orphan as a finding.
- No `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm, so no full dogfood run is owed.

## Verification

**Patch round 1, at head `5ec0b745f`** (touches only `packages/lint`, the changeset and the docs): `@objectstack/lint` `test` 161 files / 7274 tests, `typecheck` exit 0; `dispatch-gates --commands` 129 families, all exit 0, `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Ablation: replacing `if (known.has(name)) continue;` with `continue;` failed 2 of the 5 new tests, then was restored blob-identical.

The package suites ran on `8ec6209f`. The only commit after it, the final head `f444163b7`, changes the two example bundles and nothing else. Every result below is exit 0:

- `@objectstack/spec`: `test` 21786 passed, `test:repo` 1269 passed, `typecheck` passed.
- `@objectstack/cli`: unit project 4821 passed, `typecheck` passed.
- `@objectstack/rest`: `test` 6406 passed, `test:repo` 280 passed.
- `@objectstack/runtime`: `test` 7080 passed, `test:repo` 908 passed, `typecheck` passed.
- `@objectstack/lint` (7269 passed), `@objectstack/platform-objects` (1352 passed) and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (21475 passed): `test`.
- `example-crm` / `example-showcase` `typecheck` passed on `f444163b7`.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` at `f444163b7` derived 129 families. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe, and all 129 exited 0. `--ran` reports 129 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `check:generated --fix` regenerated api-surface, export-origins, references, the strictness counts and the liveness counts.
- **Ablation** (each run committed first, then restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - Deleting `position: translatePosition,` turns `i18n-security-catalog.test.ts` red (2 of 10 failed).
  - Deleting the `walkSecurityCatalog(config, out);` call turns `i18n-security-catalog-walk.test.ts` red (5 of 5 failed).
- **Reverse type check:** a `permissionSets` key under `positions.sales_rep` in the crm bundle fails `tsc` with TS2353 on the rebuilt `.d.ts`, then restores.
